Message.text: Hollowdeep. The tunnel's last lantern is behind you. The glowing moss marks the safe way; past it, the dark closes in to six paces.
Where the moss gives out, you can see six paces and no farther. A small flame, if you find one, will show you more. Nothing here asks you to wander into the dark.
The Fungal Shore. Across the water the Lamp Tree burns on its island, the first light this deep. The path north follows the moss.
A side tunnel with no moss in it. Whoever left a sword here left it in the dark on purpose.
The west passage. A cold draft comes down a shaft on the left: a lift lands there, from a place with a bell.
Glasswing Mouth. The arch to the north is a cave of crystal that hums when something moves in it. Things there are nearly invisible when still.
A ford, knee deep and unlit, runs south across the lake to the Lamp Tree's island. The water beside it is far too deep to wade.
The roots of the Lamp Tree. Something spear-shaped has been left in the hollow of one, humming with stored lightning.
Lamplight Hollow. Six lamps ring the cavern beyond the gate, all of them dark. Something vast is waiting among them.
The east shore, where the lake's glow still reaches. A stair of living roots climbs away from the far end.
The Root Stair. It climbs a long way, toward the underside of something. A loose hatch hangs at the top.
A hatch above, and a ladder folded away behind it. Push the hatch from below and the ladder comes down. It only opens this way.
